systems.system: Mapping and fibre connection of police stations (MoU, communications ministry and Police Trust Fund)
systems.country_label: MoU to map and digitalise police stations; 'smart police stations'
systems.platform: Galaxy Backbone government fibre; GIS mapping of stations against fibre points of presence
systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy with the Police Trust Fund; funds and support from the World Bank and the European Union, per the minister
systems.tiers: all police stations nationally, as intended; MoU signed Wednesday 22 April 2026; about 12 months in phases, mapping first; capacity building for officers

note: The MoU as described maps stations and connects them to fibre, with officer training: enabling class. The minister's machine that would capture a spoken report and transcribe it into a statement is given as a future he sees, not as a system being built, so no record-class system and no fact.
